zh-CN.name: 高饱和色块
zh-CN.description: 工作用视觉标签：以明确边界的大色块和较高饱和度建立分区与视觉节奏。色块需要服务层级，不能让不同功能只靠颜色来区分。
use_when: 品牌需要活力且内容可以分成清楚模块。
色彩系统能保证文字与背景对比。
avoid_when: 大量等强度色块会争夺注意力。
颜色不能替代标签、图标或状态说明。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 用有限的高饱和色块区分主要内容模块，为每个背景选择可读文字色；保留明确标题和稳定间距；主操作采用独立识别提示，减少同时竞争的强调色。

en.name: Vibrant & Block-based
en.description: A working visual label for bold, clearly bounded color blocks that organize sections and create rhythm. Color should support hierarchy rather than be the only way to distinguish functions.
use_when: The brand needs an energetic tone and content has clear modules.
The palette can maintain readable text against every surface.
avoid_when: Many equally intense blocks compete for attention.
Color cannot replace labels, icons or state explanations.
en.prompt_template: Use a limited set of vibrant blocks to separate main content modules, choosing readable text colors for each surface. Retain clear headings and stable spacing. Give primary actions independent recognition cues and avoid competing emphasis colors.
